instruction: Use BRL-CAD to read the STEP input file(s) from the Desktop path(s): /home/user/Desktop/plate_a.step, /home/user/Desktop/plate_b.step. Read /home/user/Desktop/plate_a.step and /home/user/Desktop/plate_b.step. Align the two plate centers and fuse them into a cross-shaped base. Cut one central through hole of diameter 16 mm. Then add one cylindrical pin at the center of each of the four arm end faces, each pin with diameter 10 mm and length 8 mm, with each pin axis aligned with its arm direction. Export exactly one STL mesh named /home/user/Desktop/out.stl to the output folder.
